entries.title: Psalms 105:1
segments: ¶Give ye thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; make known his acts among the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 105:2
segments: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him; meditate upon all his wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 105:3
segments: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 105:4
segments: Seek Jehovah and his strength, seek his face continually;

entries.title: Psalms 105:5
segments: Remember his wondrous works which he hath done, his miracles and the judgments of his mouth:

entries.title: Psalms 105:6
segments: Ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

entries.title: Psalms 105:7
segments: He, Jehovah, is our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 105:8
segments: ¶He is ever mindful of his covenant, --the word which he commanded to a thousand generations, --

entries.title: Psalms 105:9
segments: Which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

entries.title: Psalms 105:10
segments: And he confirmed it unto Jacob for a statute, unto Israel for an everlasting covenant,

entries.title: Psalms 105:11
segments: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

entries.title: Psalms 105:12
segments: When they were a few men in number, of small account, and strangers in it.

entries.title: Psalms 105:13
segments: And they went from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

entries.title: Psalms 105:14
segments: He suffered no man to oppress them, and reproved kings for their sakes,

entries.title: Psalms 105:15
segments: [Saying,] Touch not mine anointed ones, and do my prophets no harm.

entries.title: Psalms 105:16
segments: And he called for a famine upon the land; he broke the whole staff of bread.

entries.title: Psalms 105:17
segments: He sent a man before them: Joseph was sold for a bondman.

entries.title: Psalms 105:18
segments: They afflicted his feet with fetters; his soul came into irons;

entries.title: Psalms 105:19
segments: Until the time when what he said came about: the word of Jehovah tried him.

entries.title: Psalms 105:20
segments: The king sent and loosed him--the ruler of peoples--and let him go free.

entries.title: Psalms 105:21
segments: He made him lord of his house, and ruler over all his possessions:

entries.title: Psalms 105:22
segments: To bind his princes at his pleasure, and teach his elders wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 105:23
segments: And Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:24
segments: And he made his people exceeding fruitful, and made them mightier than their oppressors.

entries.title: Psalms 105:25
segments: ¶He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 105:26
segments: He sent Moses his servant, [and] Aaron whom he had chosen:

entries.title: Psalms 105:27
segments: They set his signs among them, and miracles in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:28
segments: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

entries.title: Psalms 105:29
segments: He turned their waters into blood, and caused their fish to die.

entries.title: Psalms 105:30
segments: Their land swarmed with frogs, --in the chambers of their kings.

entries.title: Psalms 105:31
segments: He spoke, and there came dog-flies, [and] gnats in all their borders.

entries.title: Psalms 105:32
segments: He gave them hail for rain, [and] flaming fire in their land;

entries.title: Psalms 105:33
segments: And he smote their vines and their fig-trees, and broke the trees of their borders.

entries.title: Psalms 105:34
segments: He spoke, and the locust came, and the cankerworm, even without number;

entries.title: Psalms 105:35
segments: And they devoured every herb in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

entries.title: Psalms 105:36
segments: And he smote every firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigour.

entries.title: Psalms 105:37
segments: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; and there was not one feeble among their tribes.

entries.title: Psalms 105:38
segments: Egypt rejoiced at their departure; for the fear of them had fallen upon them.

entries.title: Psalms 105:39
segments: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light in the night.

entries.title: Psalms 105:40
segments: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 105:41
segments: He opened the rock, and waters gushed forth; they ran in the dry places [like] a river.

entries.title: Psalms 105:42
segments: For he remembered his holy word, [and] Abraham his servant;

entries.title: Psalms 105:43
segments: And he brought forth his people with gladness, his chosen with rejoicing;

entries.title: Psalms 105:44
segments: And he gave them the lands of the nations, and they took possession of the labour of the peoples:

entries.title: Psalms 105:45
segments: That they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Hallelujah!
